name: grok-bot-plugin-example
description: Help publishers and Cursor AEs/FEs get an MCP server or skill into Grok Bot via the Cursor marketplace, and share a hosted assistant registry with rooms (first-load welcome prompt for lobby, register approved assistants, check into general/game rooms, room slash commands /join /leave /whos-here, operator list of who registered and who is present). Skills + remote MCP; no IDE-only components.

REGISTRY_URL.title: Registry MCP URL
REGISTRY_URL.description: HTTPS Streamable HTTP endpoint for the hosted Grok Bot registry (e.g. https://your-host.example/mcp). Local: http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp

REGISTRY_TOKEN.title: Registry bearer token
REGISTRY_TOKEN.description: Bearer token issued for this install. Prefer tokens bound to a user id in the server REGISTRY_TOKENS map. Never commit the real value.
